title: Accountability and Alignment Strategies for Implementing Edtech: How One School District Narrowed the Gap Between Promise and Practice
summary_en: The authors use two concepts from educational policy literature, accountability and alignment, to examine strategies that a school district implemented to spur the increased usage of an educational technology platform for learning math.
title_cn: Accountability and Alignment Strategies for Implementing Edtech: How One School District Narrowed the Gap Between Promise and Practice

title: Can AGI Rivals Hold Back? Verification, Domestic Oversight, and the Conditions for Mutual Restraint
summary_en: With this analysis, the authors identify the conditions under which restraint is feasible and sustainable, as well as show how these conditions shift as states come to believe that they are close to attaining artificial general intelligence.
title_cn: Can AGI Rivals Hold Back? Verification, Domestic Oversight, and the Conditions for Mutual Restraint
